evidence_required: One paragraph naming the number, why it is uncertain, and the measurement (tier and command) that would replace it.

marking.criterion: Names a specific number from Section 2.10 (for example the 10 % transient margin, the 75 % capture fraction or the 10.2 kW node maximum)
Explains why it is the least certain and what depends on it
Proposes a measurement with its tier and command (L2 BMC/DCMI and nvidia-smi sampling under burn-in, or L3 rack/CDU metering)

title: The least confident number in the fit assessment
